Wear bottom-band rebudget — 192dp, !completeEnabled

Phase 2 build: five candidates × five fixtures × two font scales × two profiles, all self-measured at runtime via getBoundingClientRect. Typeface: RobotoFlex-Regular.ttf pulled from the wear_192 device (the family wear-compose-material3 1.6.2 requests as DeviceFontFamilyName("roboto-flex")); style tokens from the library artifact (titleSmall 14/16, titleMedium 16/18, labelSmall 13/16, bodyMedium 14/16, tracking 0.4sp, wght 550/500/450, wdth 110). Palette: the ten WearPalette roles verbatim.

Fitted, disclosed: at font scale 1.24 this device applies Android's nonlinear font scaling; the mockup uses per-style multipliers fitted to the device dumps (×1.28 for 14sp/13sp styles, ×1.20 for 16sp). Every 1.24 number on this page is therefore a MODEL PREDICTION, not a measurement — 1.24 columns are tagged MODEL in the matrix. The winning candidate needs one on-device confirmation at 1.24 before any spec is written. Additionally, disconnected@1.24 value-row rest top (259.9px) is DERIVED: the card nodes are pruned from the device dump at rest, so no device measurement of it exists at either precision.
